mapper.insert: insert into tb_news(title, link, keyword_list, keyword_category, description, pubDate) values (#{title}, #{link}, #{keywordList}, #{keywordCategory}, #{description}, #{pubDate, jdbcType=OTHER}) on conflict (link) do update set keyword_list = CASE WHEN tb_news.keyword_list not like concat('%', EXCLUDED.keyword_list, '%') THEN concat(tb_news.keyword_list, ', ', EXCLUDED.keyword_list) ELSE tb_news.keyword_list END, keyword_category = CASE WHEN tb_news.keyword_category not like concat('%', EXCLUDED.keyword_category, '%') THEN concat(tb_news.keyword_category, ', ', EXCLUDED.keyword_category) ELSE tb_news.keyword_category END
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_news ORDER BY pubDate DESC

SELECT * FROM tb_news WHERE 1=1
AND keyword_category ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{category}, '%')
ORDER BY pubDate DESC
SELECT * FROM tb_news WHERE 1=1 AND ( title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR description ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') OR keyword_list ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{word}, '%') ) ORDER BY pubDate DESC
